# Tailwind Component Library Builder Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Tailwind CSS

## Overview

Builds reusable component libraries with Tailwind CSS using class composition, CVA patterns, and design system integration

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [tailwind-component-library-builder-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
tailwind-component-library-builder-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@tailwind-component-library-builder` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Build component variants with class-variance-authority (CVA)
- Implement compound variants for complex state combinations
- Create tailwind-merge safe class composition
- Design component tokens for customization

## Technology Standards Applied

- **CVA**: Class-variance-authority for variant management
- **tailwind-merge**: Intelligent class merging for overrides
- **Storybook**: Component documentation and visual testing
